findings.criterion: Post-fix production measurement over >= 500 runs — tracked by task 597e-511c-0e0f-420d
findings.detail: This criterion is explicitly unchecked in the ticket (- [ ]). The linked task 597e-511c-0e0f-420d is in status 'open' with no comments and no attestation of any production run sample having been collected. No evidence of >= 500 post-fix runs being inventoried exists in the ticket or the linked task.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment on 597e-511c-0e0f-420d (and/or 449f-f9bf-be90-47fe) with: (a) the gh run list inventory showing >= 500 post-fix Reconcile Bridge runs, (b) zero mode-1 and mode-3 failures in that window, and (c) at least one observed exit-75 notice confirming the mode-1 benign path was exercised. Include the run-id range and the date of measurement.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
